baselineDisplay.title: Which Book
baselineDisplay.question: Which book does the man want?
baselineDisplay.text:
Which book does the man want?

Give me a book please, Jane.
Which book?
This one?
No, not that one. The red one.
This one?
Yes, please.
Here you are.
Thank you.
baselineDisplay.bodyText:
Give me a book please, Jane.
Which book?
This one?
No, not that one. The red one.
This one?
Yes, please.
Here you are.
Thank you.
baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
请给我一本书，简。
“哪本书？”
“这一本吗？”
“不，不是那一本。是红色的那本。”
“这一本吗？”
是的，请给我。
“给你。”
“谢谢。”
